items.title: Add an ADDITIVE resume mode to experiments/pos-instrument-replay/run-batch.mjs: on --resume (or POS_RESUME=1), read the existing batch-ledger.jsonl, skip iterationIds already recorded (proof OR stop), run only the remaining iterations, ignore/repair a truncated trailing line, and have the strict exact-multiset end-of-run guard reconcile the FINAL ledger (== protocol cross-product, 0 dup / 0 gap). The fresh-campaign path (empty/no ledger) must be UNCHANGED so M2 batch-ledger.jsonl + selfcheck-m2 stay valid
items.context: Additive only: resume activates only when a ledger already exists and --resume is passed. A duplicate iterationId on resume is a bug (the strict guard already rejects dups). A kill before the atomic append = no record = clean re-run; a kill mid-append = a truncated last JSONL line the resume must skip/repair. Reuse lib/instrument.mjs.
items.userSees: node experiments/pos-instrument-replay/run-batch.mjs --resume (with a partial batch-ledger.jsonl present) skips already-recorded iterationIds, runs only the remaining, and the strict guard reconciles the full multiset; a fresh run (no --resume / empty ledger) behaves exactly as M2 (unchanged).

happy.desc: run-batch --resume against a partial ledger skips already-recorded iterationIds (proof OR stop), runs only the remaining, and the strict exact-multiset guard reconciles the FINAL ledger (0 dup / 0 gap)

edge.desc: a truncated trailing JSONL line (mid-append kill) is ignored/repaired by resume; that casualty iterationId then re-runs cleanly

adversarial.desc: the fresh-campaign path (no --resume / empty ledger) is UNCHANGED: M2 selfcheck-m2 still PASSes and batch-ledger.jsonl still reproduces

verificationEvidence.note: run-batch --resume against a partial ledger skips already-recorded iterationIds and runs only the remaining; the strict guard reconciles the final 30-record small multiset (0 dup / 0 gap). Proven by selfcheck-m3 boundary-kill + mid-run-crash sub-checks (append-only preserved; resume-only stale-lock break).

selfcheck-m3 E-truncated-tail: a mid-append kill leaves a partial trailing line; resume repairs-by-omission (truncates back to the last well-formed newline, dropping only the never-completed partial write) and re-runs that casualty (replay/small/5 -> proof:pass), reconciling to the exact multiset.

The resume change is ADDITIVE: selfcheck-m3 C-fresh-additive confirms a fresh run (no --resume, empty ledger) produces the exact 30-record multiset; and M2's own selfcheck-m2 STILL PASSES all 5 sub-checks (independently re-run) with batch-ledger.jsonl untouched (empty diff).

items.title: Build experiments/pos-instrument-replay/resume-probe.mjs (committed producer): spawn run-batch (small scale) and kill it deterministically TWICE — (a) at a frozen iteration boundary (SIGKILL after K iterations recorded), (b) mid-iteration via the crash hook POS_FAIL_APPEND_AT (after workspace write, before ledger append) — restart in --resume mode after each, and write resume-reconciliation.json with the pre/post-kill ledger diff, identity-multiset comparison, dup/gap counts (must be 0/0), and casualty disposition
items.context: iterationId identity-multiset must equal the protocol replay cross-product exactly. The mid-iteration casualty must resolve to a stop record OR a clean re-run, never a silent half-record. resume-reconciliation.json is the H3 evidence artifact (plan section 7).
items.userSees: node experiments/pos-instrument-replay/resume-probe.mjs kills run-batch at a boundary (SIGKILL) and mid-iteration (POS_FAIL_APPEND_AT), restarts in --resume, and writes resume-reconciliation.json showing dup=0 gap=0, identity-multiset == protocol cross-product, casualty=stop-or-rerun; prints 'H3: 0 dup / 0 gap'.

happy.desc: resume-probe.mjs spawns run-batch (small), kills it at a boundary + mid-iteration via POS_FAIL_APPEND_AT, restarts in --resume, and writes resume-reconciliation.json with pre/post-kill ledger diff + identity-multiset comparison + dup/gap counts (0/0) + casualty disposition

edge.desc: after both kills+resume the ledger has exactly one record per protocol iterationId (identity-multiset == cross-product)

adversarial.desc: the mid-iteration casualty resolves to a stop record OR a clean re-run — never a silent half-record; dup=0 gap=0

verificationEvidence.note: resume-probe.mjs kills run-batch at a boundary (hard-crash before append at replay/small/6, leaving 5 recorded + a recordless casualty) and mid-run (replay/small/18), plus an external-SIGKILL trial; restarts in --resume each time; writes resume-reconciliation.json: killA{recordedBeforeKill:5,casualty replay/small/6,dup:0,gap:0}, killB{17,replay/small/18,dup:0,gap:0}, finalMultisetMatch:true, dupTotal:0 gapTotal:0. H3: 0 dup / 0 gap.
After both kills+resume the ledger identity multiset equals the protocol replay/small cross-product exactly (finalMultisetMatch true, 0 gap) — exactly one record per iterationId.

Each mid-iteration casualty (replay/small/6 and /18) resolved to proof:pass on the clean re-run — never a silent half-record; dup=0 across both kills (the resume skips already-recorded iterationIds, the strict guard rejects any dup).

items.title: Add a hermetic mkdtemp-isolated selfcheck (selfcheck-m3.mjs) that runs the full boundary-kill + mid-iteration-crash + resume + reconciliation flow and asserts 0 dup / 0 gap, exactly one record per iterationId after resume, and that a mid-iteration casualty resolves to a stop-or-clean-rerun (never a half-record)
items.context: Per plan section 7 selfchecks: the M3 selfcheck exercises the crash hook + resume. Hermetic: mkdtemp isolation, small scale, run by node <file>. Assert the H3 evidence-complete conditions on the reconciled ledger.
items.userSees: node experiments/pos-instrument-replay/selfcheck-m3.mjs exits 0 with 'selfcheck-m3 PASS': runs the boundary-kill + mid-iteration-crash + resume + reconciliation flow hermetically and asserts 0 dup / 0 gap + exactly one record per iterationId + casualty resolves to stop-or-clean-rerun.

happy.desc: node selfcheck-m3.mjs runs the full interrupt/resume flow hermetically (mkdtemp, small) and exits 0 with PASS

edge.desc: selfcheck asserts 0 dup / 0 gap and exactly one record per protocol iterationId after the resume

adversarial.desc: selfcheck asserts the mid-iteration casualty resolved to a stop-or-clean-rerun (no silent half-record); it fails loudly if a dup/gap/half-record appears

verificationEvidence.note: node selfcheck-m3.mjs exits 0 'selfcheck-m3 PASS' (hermetic mkdtemp, small): boundary-kill+resume, mid-run-crash+resume, fresh-additivity, resume-no-ledger, truncated-tail-repair all pass.
selfcheck-m3 asserts 0 dup / 0 gap and exactly one record per protocol replay/small iterationId after each resume (finalMultisetMatch).

selfcheck-m3 asserts each mid-iteration casualty resolved to a stop-or-clean-rerun (proof:pass) — never a silent half-record; it fails loudly on any dup/gap/half-record. Two real resume bugs (stale-lock, truncated-tail) were found+fixed and are covered.
